text.id: Muncul dalam cerita rakyat Eropa sejak Abad Pertengahan; versi Sleepy Hollow terbit 1820
text.en: Appears in European folklore since the Middle Ages; the Sleepy Hollow version was published in 1820

short_description.id: Penunggang Kuda Tanpa Kepala adalah arketipe tokoh mitos dalam cerita rakyat Eropa sejak Abad Pertengahan, digambarkan sebagai penunggang kuda yang kehilangan kepalanya.
short_description.en: The Headless Horseman is an archetype of mythical figure in European folklore since the Middle Ages, depicted as a rider on horseback who has lost his head.

long_description.id: Penunggang Kuda Tanpa Kepala adalah arketipe tokoh mitos yang muncul dalam cerita rakyat di seluruh Eropa sejak Abad Pertengahan. Tokoh-tokoh itu secara tradisional digambarkan sebagai penunggang kuda yang tidak berkepala. Bergantung pada legendanya, sang Penunggang membawa kepalanya atau sama sekali kehilangannya, dan mungkin sedang mencarinya.
long_description.en: The Headless Horseman is a mythical archetype found in European folklore since the Middle Ages. Such figures are traditionally shown as riders on horseback who lack their heads. Depending on the legend, the Horseman either carries his head or has lost it altogether, and may be searching for it.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat Irlandia, dullahan adalah peri iblis tanpa kepala yang biasanya menunggang kuda dan membawa kepalanya di bawah lengan. Ia memakai cambuk dari tulang punggung mayat; ketika ia berhenti berkuda, terjadi kematian, dan ketika ia menyerukan sebuah nama, orang itu langsung mati. Dalam versi lain ia kusir kereta hitam, dan sosok serupa, gan ceann, dapat ditakuti pergi dengan benda emas. Sebagian versi menyebut dullahan sebagai roh Crom Dubh, dewa Celtic.
long_description.en: In Irish folklore the dullahan is a demonic, headless fairy who usually rides a horse with his head tucked under one arm. He wields a whip made from a corpse's spine; when he stops riding a death occurs, and when he calls out a name that person immediately dies. In another version he drives a black carriage, and a similar figure, the gan ceann, can be frightened away with a gold object. In some versions the dullahan is the spirit of Crom Dubh, a Celtic god.

long_description.id: Kisah Skotlandia yang paling menonjol menyangkut Ewen, yang dipenggal dalam pertempuran klan di Pulau Mull; di Cape Breton, melihat atau mendengar penunggang tanpa kepala dianggap pertanda kematian dalam keluarga. Di Rhineland, penunggang itu membunuh dengan sentuhan, atau sebagai Der Kopflose Reiter memperingatkan orang hidup dan menghukum orang jahat. Di Texas selatan, 'El Muerto' menggantungkan kepalanya di pelana dan kudanya memercikkan petir.
long_description.en: The most prominent Scottish tale concerns Ewen, decapitated in a clan battle on the Isle of Mull; in Cape Breton, seeing or hearing a headless rider is regarded as an omen of death in the family. In the Rhineland the horsemen killed by touch, or as Der Kopflose Reiter warned the living and punished the wicked. In southern Texas 'El Muerto' dangles his head from his saddle and his horse produces lightning.

long_description.id: Dalam The Legend of Sleepy Hollow karya Washington Irving, roh yang menghantui wilayah itu adalah penampakan sosok berkuda tanpa kepala, yang menurut sebagian orang adalah hantu prajurit Hessian yang kepalanya terbawa bola meriam dalam Perang Revolusi. Hantunya berkuda setiap malam mencari kepalanya dan terburu-buru kembali ke pemakaman sebelum fajar. Dalam kisah Brouwer, sang Penunggang tiba-tiba menjadi kerangka dan melesat dengan gelegar petir, dan dalam kisah Brom Bones ia lenyap dalam kilatan api di jembatan gereja.
long_description.en: In Washington Irving's The Legend of Sleepy Hollow the spirit that haunts the region is the apparition of a figure on horseback without a head, held by some to be the ghost of a Hessian trooper decapitated by a cannon-ball in a nameless Revolutionary War battle. The ghost rides nightly in quest of his head and hurries back to the churchyard before daybreak. In Brouwer's tale the Horseman suddenly turns into a skeleton and leaps away with a clap of thunder, and in Brom Bones's tale he vanishes in a flash of fire at the church bridge.

cultural_context.id: Mitos penunggang tanpa kepala telah mengilhami banyak kisah dan tokoh di seluruh dunia, dan sejak terbit pada 1820 Penunggang Kuda Tanpa Kepala karya Irving menjadi bagian integral cerita rakyat Amerika.
cultural_context.en: These myths have inspired many stories and characters worldwide, and Irving's Headless Horseman, published in 1820, has become an integral part of American folklore.

claims.quote: In Irish folklore ... The dullahan or dulachán ("dark man") is a headless, demonic fairy, usually riding a horse and carrying his head under his arm.

statement.id: Dullahan atau dulachán ('pria gelap') adalah peri iblis tanpa kepala yang biasanya menunggang kuda dan membawa kepalanya di bawah lengan.
statement.en: The dullahan or dulachán ('dark man') is a headless, demonic fairy, usually riding a horse and carrying his head under his arm.

claims.quote: The dullahan or dulachán ("dark man") is a headless, demonic fairy ... He wields a whip made from a human corpse's spine. When the dullahan stops riding, a death occurs. The dullahan calls out a name, at which point the named person immediately dies.

statement.id: Dullahan menggunakan cambuk dari tulang punggung mayat manusia; ketika dullahan berhenti berkuda, terjadi kematian, dan ketika ia menyerukan sebuah nama, orang yang disebut langsung mati.
statement.en: The dullahan wields a whip made from a human corpse's spine; when the dullahan stops riding, a death occurs, and when he calls out a name, the named person immediately dies.

claims.quote: In another version, he is the headless driver of a black carriage, the Cóiste Bodhar. A similar figure, the gan ceann ("without a head"), can be frightened away by wearing a gold object or putting one in his path.

statement.id: Dalam versi lain, ia adalah kusir tanpa kepala dari kereta hitam, Cóiste Bodhar; sosok serupa, gan ceann ('tanpa kepala'), dapat ditakuti pergi dengan mengenakan benda emas atau meletakkannya di jalurnya.
statement.en: In another version he is the headless driver of a black carriage, the Cóiste Bodhar; a similar figure, the gan ceann ('without a head'), can be frightened away by wearing a gold object or putting one in his path.

claims.quote: The most prominent Scottish tale of the headless horseman concerns a man named Ewen decapitated in a clan battle at Glen Cainnir on the Isle of Mull.

statement.id: Kisah penunggang kuda tanpa kepala Skotlandia yang paling menonjol menyangkut seorang pria bernama Ewen yang dipenggal dalam pertempuran klan di Glen Cainnir, Pulau Mull.
statement.en: The most prominent Scottish tale of the headless horseman concerns a man named Ewen decapitated in a clan battle at Glen Cainnir on the Isle of Mull.

claims.quote: Among the Highland Scottish diaspora in Cape Breton, Nova Scotia, seeing the image or hearing the sound of a horse or headless rider is traditionally regarded as an omen of an imminent death within the family.

statement.id: Di kalangan diaspora Highland Skotlandia di Cape Breton, Nova Scotia, melihat bayangan atau mendengar suara kuda atau penunggang tanpa kepala secara tradisional dianggap pertanda kematian dalam keluarga yang segera terjadi.
statement.en: Among the Highland Scottish diaspora in Cape Breton, Nova Scotia, seeing the image or hearing the sound of a horse or headless rider is traditionally regarded as an omen of an imminent death within the family.

claims.quote: In Germany, headless-horseman stories come mostly from the Rhineland. Rather than using decapitation, the headless horsemen killed their victims simply by touching them. They were revenants who had to wander the earth until they had atoned for their sins

statement.id: Di Jerman, kisah penunggang kuda tanpa kepala kebanyakan berasal dari Rhineland; penunggang itu membunuh korban hanya dengan menyentuh mereka, dan mereka adalah arwah yang harus mengembara di bumi sampai menebus dosa.
statement.en: In Germany, headless-horseman stories come mostly from the Rhineland; the headless horsemen killed their victims simply by touching them and were revenants who had to wander the earth until they had atoned for their sins.

claims.quote: Another version of the legend spoke of Der Kopflose Reiter (the headless horseman), who would warn the living of impending danger and chase down and punish the wicked.

statement.id: Versi lain legenda itu menyebut Der Kopflose Reiter (penunggang kuda tanpa kepala), yang memperingatkan orang hidup akan bahaya yang mengancam serta mengejar dan menghukum orang jahat.
statement.en: Another version of the legend spoke of Der Kopflose Reiter (the headless horseman), who would warn the living of impending danger and chase down and punish the wicked.

claims.quote: In southern Texas, stories of a figure known as "El Muerto" have circulated since the mid-1800s. El Muerto is said to dangle his head from his saddle, and his horse is variably said to produce lightning from its hooves as they strike the ground.

statement.id: Di Texas selatan, kisah tentang sosok bernama 'El Muerto' beredar sejak pertengahan 1800-an; ia dikatakan menggantungkan kepalanya di pelana, dan kudanya dikatakan memercikkan petir dari kukunya ketika menghentak tanah.
statement.en: In southern Texas, stories of a figure known as 'El Muerto' have circulated since the mid-1800s; El Muerto is said to dangle his head from his saddle, and his horse is variably said to produce lightning from its hooves as they strike the ground.

claims.quote: Washington Irving's short story The Legend of Sleepy Hollow features a character known as the Headless Horseman. It may have been inspired, at least in part, by the rumored discovery of a headless corpse in the area after the Revolutionary War Battle of White Plains

statement.id: Cerita pendek Washington Irving The Legend of Sleepy Hollow menampilkan tokoh bernama Penunggang Kuda Tanpa Kepala; tokoh itu mungkin terinspirasi, setidaknya sebagian, oleh kabar penemuan mayat tanpa kepala di daerah itu setelah Pertempuran White Plains dalam Perang Revolusi.
statement.en: Washington Irving's short story The Legend of Sleepy Hollow features a character known as the Headless Horseman, which may have been inspired, at least in part, by the rumored discovery of a headless corpse in the area after the Revolutionary War Battle of White Plains.

claims.quote: Then again, Irving was probably familiar with the European folklore in which the figure of a headless rider has appeared since the Middle Ages. In any case, since its publication in 1820, Irving's Headless Horseman has become an integral part of American folklore.

statement.id: Namun Irving mungkin akrab dengan cerita rakyat Eropa tempat sosok penunggang tanpa kepala muncul sejak Abad Pertengahan; bagaimanapun, sejak terbit pada 1820, Penunggang Kuda Tanpa Kepala karya Irving menjadi bagian integral cerita rakyat Amerika.
statement.en: Irving was probably familiar with the European folklore in which the figure of a headless rider has appeared since the Middle Ages; in any case, since its publication in 1820, Irving's Headless Horseman has become an integral part of American folklore.

claims.quote: The Headless Horseman appears in "The Legend of Sleepy Hollow" segment of the 1949 film The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad.

statement.id: Penunggang Kuda Tanpa Kepala muncul dalam segmen 'The Legend of Sleepy Hollow' pada film The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad (1949).
statement.en: The Headless Horseman appears in 'The Legend of Sleepy Hollow' segment of the 1949 film The Adventures of Ichabod and Mr. Toad.

claims.quote: While the original story implies that the Horseman was merely Brom Bones in disguise, the film depicts him as an actual ghost.

statement.en: While the original story implies that the Horseman was merely Brom Bones in disguise, the film depicts him as an actual ghost.

summary.id: Menurut sebagian orang dalam cerita, hantu prajurit Hessian yang kepalanya terbawa bola meriam.
summary.en: Said by some in the story to be the ghost of a Hessian trooper whose head a cannon-ball carried away.

topic.en: Whether the Horseman is a real ghost

summary.id: Cerita asli menyiratkan ia hanya Brom Bones yang menyamar.
summary.en: The original story implies he is merely Brom Bones in disguise.
The 1949 film depicts him as an actual ghost.
